primary_hypothesis.text: Under a frozen partial-evidence action budget and unchanged non-escalating authority lattice, defeater-directed protected acquisition reduces unresolved critical authority risk versus static P4 V2 blocking without increasing false authority promotion.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Correct next protected action is selected over cheaper decoys and unprotected substitutes.
Absence of an admissible protected action yields CANNOT_CHECK rather than manufactured AUTHORIZE.

resource_policy: Every runnable policy shares the frozen action registry, cost envelope, authority lattice, evaluator identity and hidden labels. The planner may choose among admissible actions only.
exclusion_policy: No case is removed after planner choice. Missing protected evidence or host yields CANNOT_CHECK and remains in the denominator.

statistics.interval: Wilson 95% intervals for rates; paired percentile bootstrap for matched differences
statistics.multiplicity: Single primary false-promotion guard; Holm correction for secondary action-selection comparisons

access_policy.search_contamination_policy: candidate cannot observe attack labels, holdout labels, gold terminals, or planner-private protected evidence; all accesses logged
